conflicts.description: The manual prints a physical Left EOS contact at matrix 15 and does not mark it as a cabinet switch. FLIP1516 and the retained key handler put left cabinet-button state at public 15.
conflicts.rationale: An end-of-stroke contact exists so a physical coil's power winding is cut before it burns, and a recreation has no coil to protect. This platform models no EOS at all -- the driver macro uses FLIP_SWNO without FLIP_SOL, so core.c's EOS simulation never runs -- and PinMAME publishes cabinet-button state at this address instead. Which of the two names belongs on it cannot change any table. The record is kept because it explains this address's conflicted provenance; it is not an outstanding question.

conflicts.description: The manual's paired L/R wiring and retained active callbacks make public 1-8 flash lamps and 25-32 mechanisms. Torpedo Alley's pinned s11.c block instead types only public 25-32 as eight muxed #89 bulbs; the semantic map follows the manual/runtime agreement and retains the emulator typing disagreement. Resolution path: a corrected torp_ output-typing block in upstream src/wpc/s11.c, which a PinMAME contributor can submit against the manual's own printed L/R wiring, or a LibPinMAME trace against a legal torp_e21 ROM captured in both K1 relay states observing what the emulator publishes at 1-8 and at 25-32. Unresolved.

The Coil Test table and coil-location plan print SP1 Center Thumper Bumper and SP2 Right Thumper Bumper. The special-coil wiring diagram prints SP2 Center and SP1 Right. The two-against-one working labels are used without erasing the schematic cells. Resolution path: a photograph or continuity check of an unrestored playfield tracing the printed BLU-ORN CPU CN19-3 and BLU-RED CPU CN19-4 control leads to the center and right thumper-bumper bodies, or a LibPinMAME gameplay-harness trace against a legal torp_e21 ROM that starts a ball and closes each bumper's own switch while watching public 17 and 22. Unresolved.

Manual and pinned s11.c identify output 11 as the general-illumination relay. The retained script assigns GIUpdate to 11, then later overwrites the same SolCallback array slot with Sol11BG, so the known-working table's effective callback is a backglass proxy. Resolution path: the disagreement is with the retained table rather than with the machine, so what would close it is a corrected build of that table, or a second independently authored known-working Torpedo Alley recreation whose SolCallback(11) survives to drive general illumination; a table author can supply either. Unresolved.

The manual assigns 23 to Bottom Left Star Rollover and the extraction contains SW23 at that location, but active SW23_Hit pulses public switch 18 (Left Return). Resolution path: a continuity check or photograph of an unrestored playfield tracing the bottom left star rollover back to the GRN-ORN drive and WHT-VIO return the printed matrix gives address 23, or a second independently authored known-working Torpedo Alley recreation whose bottom-left-star handler pulses 23 rather than 18. Unresolved.

The manual assigns 36 to Right Star Rollover and the extraction contains SW36 at that location, but active SW36_Hit pulses public switch 26 (S lane). Resolution path: a continuity check or photograph of an unrestored playfield tracing the right star rollover back to the GRN-BLK drive and WHT-YEL return the printed matrix gives address 36, or a second independently authored known-working Torpedo Alley recreation whose right-star handler pulses 36 rather than 26. Unresolved.

The manual fits lamp 24 as Insert 1 Torpedo (2) and the extraction has an L24 Light object. The script's only Lights(24) assignment is whole-line commented, so shared VPM lamp polling cannot reach it through this table's active membership array. Resolution path: a photograph of an unrestored playfield confirming that two Insert 1 Torpedo bulbs hang on the YEL-ORN drive and RED-GRY return the printed matrix gives address 24, together with a LibPinMAME trace against a legal torp_e21 ROM observing whether the ROM drives public lamp 24 outside its own lamp test; a corrected build of the retained table, or a second known-working recreation whose Lights(24) assignment is live, would supply the runtime binding. Unresolved.

mechanisms.behavior: Drain_Hit adds a drained ball to the retained BallStack. Output 31 is its SolIn path, moving the ball from the manual's outhole position into the three-ball trough.
mechanisms.label: Outhole feeder

mechanisms.behavior: The retained BallStack initializes three balls across switches 13, 12 and 11. Output 16 invokes SolOut and kicks through BallRelease toward the shooter lane.
mechanisms.label: Three-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: The retained callback fires and retracts Plunger1 on output 25; SW17 reports the Laser Kick contact. The manual independently names 01R Laser Kicker, but the script does not expose pulse timing.
mechanisms.label: Laser Kick

mechanisms.behavior: LLKICK destroys the incoming table ball and adds it to a BallStack whose two staged positions are switches 42 then 41. Output 26 invokes SolOut through Kicker2.
mechanisms.label: Two-position left kicker lock

mechanisms.behavior: VUK_Hit starts a timer that asserts switch 43. Output 27 recreates and raises the ball, then kicks it at 130 degrees and clears switch 43. The manual assembly supplies the coil/plunger/spring construction.
mechanisms.label: Vertical up kicker

mechanisms.behavior: RLKICK adds the ball to a two-position BallStack at switches 45 then 44. Output 28 invokes SolOut through Kicker1 with KickBalls=2.
mechanisms.label: Two-position center kicker lock

mechanisms.behavior: Each target reports its own switch. Output 29 starts the retained reset animation and calls DropSol_On to return all three targets.
mechanisms.label: Three-target drop bank

mechanisms.behavior: Output 32 starts SinkShip_Timer, which rocks Ship through a fourteen-step RotY sequence and returns it to zero. The manual's 500-5084-00 assembly shows the 30-800 coil pulling a linked, spring-returned ship mounting plate carrying the periscope lens.
mechanisms.label: Sinking ship / periscope tilt

mechanisms.behavior: The retained left callback moves one lower-left flipper. The manual prints switch 15 as a physical EOS contact, while PinMAME and the table feed cabinet-button state there.
mechanisms.label: Lower-left flipper

mechanisms.behavior: One retained right callback moves both right flippers. The manual prints two right flipper coils sharing the cabinet-button circuit and one Right EOS matrix contact; no separate upper-right EOS address is printed.
mechanisms.label: Lower-right and upper-right flippers

mechanisms.behavior: A passive spinner pulses switch 25; no CPU actuator is present.
mechanisms.label: Top-left spinner

mechanisms.behavior: A passive spinner pulses switch 32; no CPU actuator is present.
mechanisms.label: Right spinner

mechanisms.behavior: The retained Bumper3 hit handler pulses switch 49. The manual's location plan and SP4 wiring identify the left thumper circuit; Data East PIA SS4 is public solenoid 19. The missing VPX SolCallback leaves its actuator placement unresolved, not its physical circuit.
mechanisms.label: Left thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The retained Bumper1 hit handler pulses switch 50. The manual's location plan and SP2 wiring identify the right thumper circuit; Data East PIA SS2 is public solenoid 22. The manual's SP1/SP2 description conflict remains explicit and placement remains unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Right thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The retained Bumper2 hit handler pulses switch 51. The manual's location plan and SP1 wiring identify the center thumper circuit; Data East PIA SS1 is public solenoid 17. The manual's SP1/SP2 description conflict remains explicit and placement remains unresolved.
mechanisms.label: Center thumper bumper

mechanisms.behavior: The retained LeftSlingShot event pulses switch 52. The manual prints SP3 construction and Data East PIA SS3 is public solenoid 18; the literal manual cell `Left Slingsho` is normalized only for this device label. The missing VPX SolCallback leaves placement unresolved, not circuit topology.
mechanisms.label: Left slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: The retained RightSlingShot event pulses switch 53. The manual prints SP5 construction and Data East PIA SS5 is public solenoid 21. The missing VPX SolCallback leaves placement unresolved, not circuit topology.
mechanisms.label: Right slingshot

mechanisms.behavior: The cabinet parts illustration prints a ball-shooter assembly. The player-driven launch path crosses shooter-lane switch 14; no CPU shooter coil is claimed.
mechanisms.label: Manual plunger and shooter lane

mechanisms.behavior: The playfield parts illustration shows fixed ramp/wireform hardware. Switch 46 reports ramp traversal; the retained script contains no diverter or ramp motor.
mechanisms.label: Fixed ramp and wireform paths
